<!-- _tbl-glm.qmd -->
```{r tbl-glm, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE }
#| tbl-cap: Multivariable logistic regression of factors associated with climate anxiety
#| results: asis

if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  cat(readLines(here::here("Outputs", "tables", "glm_tab.tex")), sep = "\n")
} else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  cat(readLines(here::here("Outputs", "tables", "glm_tab.html")), sep = "\n")
} else if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {
  # Word needs a paragraph after a table that ends a cell; without one
  # the Quarto caption wrapper triggers "unreadable content" in Word
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(lancet_ft(readRDS(here::here("Outputs", "tables", "glm_tab_ft.rds"))))
  cat("\n\n```{=openxml}\n<w:p/>\n```\n\n")
}
```

```{r glm-notes}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Word only: table notes as paragraphs below the table (HTML and LaTeX
# tables carry their own notes). Kept out of the table chunk so Quarto
# does not mistake a note for the caption.
if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {
  cat_table_notes(readRDS(here::here("Outputs", "tables", "glm_tab_notes.rds")))
}
```
